WEEK 1

Three days in

{{ first_name|default:'there' }}, how is {{ event.plan_title }} feeling? Two
things help most in week 1:

1. Start lighter than you think. Finish every set with 2 reps in reserve; add
weight next week.
2. Protein and sleep do the building. Aim for a protein serving within two
hours of training and 7+ hours of sleep.
